proposal.reason: Main change is review-routing/approval automation behavior, owned by workflow: .github/workflows/review-routing.yml now passes pr_number from classify JSON output, .github/workflows/review-gate.yml adds an identify job and normalized PR-based concurrency key, and .github/scripts/maintainer_approval.py adds identify/refresh modes with stricter PR-number normalization/validation for gate association. .github/scripts/review_automation.py and .github/scripts/reviewer_api.py change invitation-withdrawal handling (HTTP 422 downgraded to warning) and safe GitHub error diagnostics, which are reviewer-assignment/approval workflow mechanics. .github/skills/pccl-review-assignment/modules.json edits are module-catalog/classification-boundary maintenance, explicitly scoped to workflow rather than runtime PCCL modules.
